result.title: Generative Text Modelling and Language-Guided Visual Attention for Deciphering Palimpsests
result.comment: This is a pre-MIT Press publication version, accepted for publication at TACL
result.summary: Recovering obscured text in palimpsests, i.e. the manuscripts where the original writing (under-text) was erased and overwritten for reuse, is vital for preserving lost information. Due to the nature of the material, such a task can be highly challenging and time-consuming. This paper presents an approach towards automated palimpsest handwritten text modeling for under-text recovery. We investigate generative models, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and diffusion models, and design a custom denoising diffusion model that learns structured noise patterns to reconstruct the under-text. The recovered text is subsequently processed by a fine-tuned, attention-based handwritten text recognition network. Furthermore, we investigate a language-guided recognition framework that leverages textual class descriptions as informative priors, enabling the text recognition model to distinguish meaningful features from noise. This is achieved by grounding task-specific descriptions, phrased in words or sentences, through visual attention maps generated by pretrained vision-language models like CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training). To facilitate future research and benchmarking, we release new datasets for synthetic palimpsests (currently scarce), CLIP-compatible text descriptions, and pre-trained models with code.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究羊皮纸重写本（palimpsest）中被擦除底层文本的自动恢复：用 GAN 与自定义扩散模型重建底层文字，再由微调的手写文本识别网络处理，并提出以 CLIP 生成的视觉注意力图将文本类别描述落地为识别先验，同时发布合成数据与预训练模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用语言描述引导 CLIP 视觉注意力、把有意义特征与噪声区分开」的做法，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选及注意力/位置结构如何影响 latent 内容提供可核查的方法线索，但原文面向古籍复原，迁移到多模态推理的有效性尚待验证。
